test_objective: Check that one can create a implicitlycreated @context through creating a subscription

test_cases.name: 050_03_01 Check the creation of ImplicitelyCreted @context
test_cases.doc: Check that one can create a subscription
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/jsonldContexts?${params_as_string}'
        method set to 'GET'
        List @contexts: and
    Query Parameter: details set to 'true' and
    Query Parameter: kind set to 'ImplicitlyCreated'
}
